description: One graphrag_search result's graph blocks and the lines they render as. Pinned on both sides so the two renderings cannot drift: the Python renderer (context_render.render_retrieved_context, test_context_render.py) and the interface's mirror (graphBlocks.ts, graphBlocks.test.ts). lines are what the tool item shows; prompt_lines what the model reads: the same lines inside the untrusted-document fence with its [GRAPH EVIDENCE] header (the quoted sentences are document text). quote_chars is the longest evidence sentence a block quotes (graphrag_blocks.EVIDENCE_QUOTE_CHARS).
